parallel_persistence_rule: GPR, CWKS and FGA are independent persistent implementation lanes with separate milestone-only lane-state refs. Terminal MSAS, MRCS, OARC and CASI remain completed history outside the persistent slots. If two or more persistent lanes are nonterminal, immutable green READY candidates use FIFO publication coordination. If exactly one persistent lane is nonterminal, the READY queue is dormant and protected-main publication uses the direct exact-head fresh-base path.
single_active_lane_rule: Derive single-active-lane mode once from the fresh CURRENT read. Ordinary execution reads and mutates only that lane plus concrete dependencies/conflicts; it does not rescan terminal siblings, check concurrent writers, read an empty READY queue, or perform routine rebase/update-branch work. Protected-main publication is PR-only, exact-head and fresh-base, with a narrow integration rerun only if main actually drifts.
quiet_execution_rule: Healthy CI is observed at workflow level only at sparse transition-driven points. Job/step/log inspection is failure-driven. Lane scans, queue-empty checks, rebase checks, mergeability polling and owner re-entry are not material progress and must not create lane-state receipts. Browser/session interruption resumes from durable lane state and repository evidence rather than requiring another owner Continue.
